title: Soups & Stews
description: A simple data pack adding more soup and stew related items to the game, varying in use and ability.
body: # Soups & Stews ### Current Version - v0.1 Craft new stews and soups added to the base game, ranging from more powerful suspicious stews, to unique takes on pre-existing items, like beef or cod stew. It achieves this all while maintaining a vanilla-friendly feel to the game. The added variety to this family of food allows greater freedom in the kitchen, and more culinary creativity to be practiced! Explore the unique world of soups and stews! Includes functional recipes for: - Bamboo Soup - *Special food* - Provides Haste for a short period. - Beef Stew - *Simple food* - Brown Mushroom Soup - *Simple food* - Cactus Soup - *Simple food* - Chicken Stew - *Simple food* - Cod Stew - *Simple food* - God Stew - *Special food* - Provides Jump Boost, Regeneration, Fire Resistance, Night Vision, & Saturation for the same durations they provide in individual Suspicious Stews. - Mutton Stew - *Simple food* - Pork Stew - *Simple food* - Rabbit Stew (Shapeless) - *Simple food* - Red Mushroom Soup - *Simple food* - Turtle Stew - *Special food* - Provides Dolphin's Grace for a short period. Resource pack coming soon, some custom item names *may* be missing. See Gallery for referenced functional recipes. ## Installation Put the data pack .zip file into the `datapacks` folder of your Minecraft world. ## External Links
